state_directory.description: Directory where certmonger stores persistent state (certificates, keys, request metadata). Must be writable by the certmonger daemon.

tmp_directory.description: Directory for temporary files (e.g., CSRs, certificate chains). Should be cleared on reboot.

log_directory.description: Directory for log files. Set to empty string ("") to disable file logging.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 0=none, 1=errors only, 2=warnings, 3=info (recommended), 4=debug. Higher levels increase disk usage and reduce performance.

max_pending_requests.description: Maximum number of concurrent certificate requests (e.g., from enrollment or renewal). Increase if you experience 'too many pending' errors.

ca_cache_ttl.description: How long (in seconds) to cache CA metadata (e.g., certificate chains, OCSP status). Set to 0 to disable caching (not recommended).

max_ca_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts when contacting a CA. Set to 0 to retry indefinitely (e.g., for offline CAs).

ca_retry_delay.description: Delay (in seconds) between consecutive CA contact retries. Increasing this helps avoid overwhelming slow or rate-limited CAs.

start_renewer_daemon.description: Whether to auto-start background renewal daemons for services (e.g., HTTP-based OCSP responders). Disable only in headless or containerized environments.

helpers_directory.description: Path to the directory containing CA helper scripts (e.g., for NSS, Apache, Nginx). Must match the installed certmonger package.

default.name: nss
default.description: Supports local NSS databases (used by 389 Directory Server, Firefox, etc.)

default.name: http
default.description: Generic HTTP/JSON-based CA (e.g., Dogtag PKI, EJBCA)

ca_types.description: List of CA types certmonger can interact with. Each item defines a CA type name, helper binary, and optional command-line arguments.

name.description: Unique identifier for the CA type (e.g., 'nss', 'http', 'pki')

binary.description: Helper binary or script (must exist in helpers_directory) used to manage this CA type.

args.description: Optional command-line arguments passed to the helper binary (e.g., CA URL). Leave empty if not needed.

description.description: Human-readable description used for documentation (not parsed).

cache_ca_profiles.description: Whether to cache CA profile names (e.g., 'subCA', 'serverAuth'). Only affects some CA types (e.g., Dogtag).
